status: FROZEN — no parameter may change in response to live results

signal_universe.comment: Binance USD-M perpetual symbols used to BUILD the signal. This is the PCA and ranking universe and it does not change if a name turns out to be untradable on the execution venue.

pca.standardization: per-asset z-score using the trailing window's own mean and sd
pca.sign_convention: each component flipped so its loadings sum positive
pca.warmup_policy: bars before the first full window are dropped, never zero-filled

components.comment: Ten signals. Each is a cross-sectional vector, z-scored across assets, then averaged with equal weight. No subsetting.
components.residual_definition: asset return minus its reconstruction from the first 3 PCs, in bps
components.component_zscore: cross-sectional, across assets, per component, per rebalance
components.aggregation: arithmetic mean of the 10 z-scored components, equal weight

portfolio.neutralization: project the PC1 loading vector out of the weight vector, then rescale to restore gross
portfolio.hysteresis: none — rank hysteresis was tested and measurably reduced return
portfolio.vol_targeting: none — tested at 15/25/35% and measurably reduced Sharpe and Calmar

cost_assumptions.comment: Measured Kalshi one-way cost to cross, in bps of notional, per coin. 12.00 of each is the tier-0 taker fee. Charged on weight CHANGES only.

research_result_frozen_against.gate_status: net_lo PASSES; excess_lo against a volatility-matched always-long FAILS at -0.0007
research_result_frozen_against.honest_label: not a proven profitable strategy — this deployment is live execution validation

feasibility_thresholds.comment: Set BEFORE measuring anything about contract sizes or account equity. If the live integer book cannot meet ALL of these, the deployment falls back to SHADOW + EXECUTION_CANARY and real PnL is not labelled PORTFOLIO_V1.

execution.taker_fallback: allowed only if the remaining expected benefit still exceeds the all-in taker cost plus the safety buffer
execution.skip_policy: if neither maker nor taker clears the buffer, skip the leg and log it

no_trade_test.comment: A change in target weight is not a reason to trade. Estimated marginal benefit must exceed the round-trip cost plus buffer.
